question: Choose the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the killer whale population and indicates that it is experiencing a decline.
 
• The phrase "on the decline" is commonly used to describe something that is decreasing or deteriorating over time.
 
• Therefore, using "on" correctly fits the context of the population being in a state of decline.
 
• Other options like "at," "after," and "off" do not convey the intended meaning in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Sniffer dog Tucker uses his__ nose to help researchers find out why a killer whale population off the northwest coast of the United States is __on__ the decline. He searches for whale faeces floating on the surface of the water, which are then collected for examination. He is one of the elite team members of detection dogs used by scientists studying a **_________**of species including right whales and killer whales.* ​*Conservation canines are fast becoming indispensable tools for biologists according to Aimee Hurt, associate director and co-founder of Working Dogs for Conservation, **_________**in Three Forks, Montana. Over the last few years, though, so many new conservation dog projects have sprung up that Hurt can no **_________**keep track of them all. Her organisation’s dogs and their handlers are fully booked to assist field researchers into 2012.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• At (पर): This does not fit the context of something being in a state of decline.
 
• After (के बाद): This suggests a sequence or time, not a state.
 
• Off (बंद): This suggests separation or removal, not a gradual decline.
